name: Cloudflare
purpose: DNS, TLS, CDN, WAF, and the public edge for every client domain.

tasks.title: Move the client domain onto Cloudflare DNS
steps: Add the zone and switch nameservers at the registrar
Proxy (orange-cloud) the app records; leave mail records DNS-only
Add the DNS records Clerk (NN-CLERK-01) and the host need
tasks.doneWhen: Zone is Active and the app resolves through Cloudflare.

tasks.title: Enforce TLS
steps: Always Use HTTPS on; minimum TLS 1.2; HSTS once the site is stable
tasks.doneWhen: SSL Labs grade A or better.

tasks.title: Turn on WAF and rate limiting
steps: Rate-limit auth and AI endpoints (sign-in, /api/assistant, voice/image routes)
tasks.doneWhen: A burst test against /api/* is throttled.

tasks.title: Put admin and staging behind Cloudflare Access
steps: Create an Access application for staging and admin hostnames
Allow only the team's identity provider group
tasks.doneWhen: Staging asks for login before it loads.

tasks.title: Scope the API token
steps: Create a token limited to this zone with only DNS edit and cache purge
Store it as a GitHub Actions secret, never in the repo
tasks.doneWhen: Token works for DNS and purge only.

tasks.title: Purge cache after deploy
steps: Purge by URL or tag from the deploy workflow
tasks.doneWhen: The live site serves the new build.
